title: Sharing Notes After an Absence
transcript:
I'm back after missing two history lectures, and I'm trying to catch up. I downloaded the slides, but several pages contain only pictures with no explanation.
Those pictures were examples the lecturer discussed. My notes include the main points, although I sometimes wrote questions in the margin when I wasn't sure about something.
Would you mind sending me a copy? I don't want to mistake your questions for facts, so perhaps we could go through the unclear parts together.
Of course. I've marked my own questions with a star. The lecturer also recorded the first session, but the microphone failed during the second.
Then I'll listen to the first recording before we meet. Was there anything we need to prepare for next week's seminar?
Yes. We must compare two newspaper accounts of the same event. The links are on the course page, below the slides rather than in the reading list.
I probably would have missed those. Can we meet tomorrow afternoon after your language class? I'd like to work out which points I still need to ask the lecturer about.
Tomorrow is fine, but I have a part time shift at four. We could use the library study area from two until three.
That should be enough. I'll bring the articles and a list of specific questions, so we don't spend the hour copying everything.
Good idea. If a point is still unclear, we can put it in the course discussion forum and ask the lecturer to explain it.

questions.prompt: Why are the lecture slides alone insufficient for the student?
options: They belong to a different history course.
They can only be opened inside the classroom.
They have been removed from the course website.
Some pictures lack the explanations given during the lecture.
questions.answer: Some pictures lack the explanations given during the lecture.
questions.explanation: 部分幻灯片只有图片，具体解释是在课堂讨论中口头给出的。

questions.prompt: How are uncertain points identified in the other student's notes?
options: They are marked with a star.
They are written on a separate website.
They are placed before every lecture title.
questions.answer: They are marked with a star.
questions.explanation: 同学用星号标出自己的疑问，避免被误当作确定事实。

questions.prompt: What must the students prepare for the seminar?
options: A recording of two missed lectures.
A comparison of two reports about the same event.
A translation of all the lecture slides.
A list of questions from every class member.
questions.answer: A comparison of two reports about the same event.
questions.explanation: 下次研讨课需要比较两家报纸对同一事件的报道。

questions.prompt: What will the returning student bring to the meeting?
options: A replacement microphone for the lecturer.
Printed copies of every lecture from the course.
The articles and a list of specific questions.
A completed report for the other student's language class.
questions.answer: The articles and a list of specific questions.
questions.explanation: 学生计划带上文章和具体问题，提高一小时讨论的效率。
